method: Model-judged audit, NOT human-verified. Read every unmatched finding's full critique+suggestion in editorial-2026-10-14-flash38.raw.json against the planted-issue scripts, gold labels, and video briefs. Classes: duplicate (same moment+problem as a matched gold issue or a sibling finding), valid_unplanted (real, specific, actionable problem a careful editor would raise; not planted), nitpick (defensible but reasonably ignorable), spurious (misreads transcript, false fact-check, contradicts brief, or invents). Truth claims checked against USDA/FDA guidance and standard espresso-extraction, US-retirement-account, EU-egg-storage, and Python-semantics facts; web search used only to confirm these facts. Same standard applied to all arms without knowing which is the product's.
